texts: English author and humorist Douglas Adams was an English author, humourist and screenwriter, best known for The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy.
Chemical element with atomic number 79 Gold is a chemical element with the symbol Au. It is a bright, slightly orange-yellow, dense, soft, malleable metal.
Capital city of France Paris is the capital and largest city of France, on the river Seine in the north of the country.
Branch of mathematics Topology is the study of properties of geometric objects that are preserved under continuous deformations.
Association football club Liverpool Football Club is a professional football club based in Liverpool, England.
Family of flowering plants The Rosaceae, the rose family, is a medium-sized family of flowering plants including apples, pears, cherries and roses.
1962 confrontation The Cuban Missile Crisis was a 13-day confrontation between the governments of the United States and the Soviet Union.
Programming language Python is a high-level, general-purpose programming language whose design philosophy emphasizes code readability.
